tools.faultServer: Java HttpServer on loopback with actual AWS SDK 2.54.12
tools.environment: Bash + isolated Docker Compose with PostgreSQL, Kafka, DynamoDB Local and Redis
tools.performance: k6 v1.8.1 binary and Docker daemon checked; no load test run

verified: DLT recovery and delivery inspection CLIs now share one local DynamoDB client configuration
The local client uses a ten-second API budget, five-second attempt budget, and STANDARD retry with at most three attempts including the initial request
Three actual HTTP 503 responses stop the call; the same client succeeds on the next call after the server recovers
Full Java integration regression passed after the CLI changes
limits: The HTTP fault server verifies SDK transport behavior, not real DynamoDB persistence or a multi-Pod recovery burst
The CLI clients are local-only and do not inherit Spring properties; Redis and Kafka client reconnect behavior remains to be reviewed
This is a regression run, not a sustained k6, Pod capacity or 10000 TPS measurement
